title: 午夜辩论
detail: An androgynously elegant woman with precisely slicked side part and sculptural folded low knot at nape, a single silver hair pin, thin small oval spectacles. Experimental scholarly layering: oversized aged-ivory crisp poplin shirt with exaggerated long pointed collar and voluminous sleeves gathered at narrow cuffs; over it an ink-black British barathea sleeveless waistcoat with very deep armholes and long asymmetric apron-like front panel. Dramatically wide black fine corduroy knee-length culottes with deep box pleats, oxblood fine wool knee socks and chunky polished black square-toe heeled Oxford shoes. A charcoal cropped capelet jacket hangs over just one shoulder, not a second long coat. Pose: seated on edge of a dark oak seminar table, torso upright, feet both planted separated naturally, one hand braced behind on table and other holding a closed folio beside thigh, confident direct level gaze. Frame complete shoes and full outfit. Scene: deserted wood-panelled debating chamber, tall blackboard with faint illegible erased marks, cool high window illumination, tiny amber light in background. Fashion impact from extreme shirt volume against architectural vest and culottes, not jeans or basic casualwear. Transform photo's black blazer plus jeans into completely new shirt/vest/culotte proportion.

title: 雨廊来信
detail: A poised woman with slick wet-look black hair swept tightly back into a high long braided ponytail, two architectural braided loops at crown; cool smoky eyes. Original monumental storm silhouette: near-black moss boiled-wool coat, broad sculptural raised collar, asymmetrical storm yoke that creates a short cape across shoulders, exaggerated cocoon sleeves, defined waist with narrow oxblood leather belt, long mid-calf flaring hem with one angled front opening revealing a dark charcoal sharply pleated mini kilt and black opaque tights. Long black polished knee-high boots with sculpted moderate heel. Tiny flashes of original broken-window charcoal/oxblood jacquard inside coat opening, NOT Burberry check. Restrained chunky charcoal knit at neck, no copied wavy zipper or fringed cuffs. Pose: decisive side-three-quarter walking stride through archway, head upright looking over shoulder with chin level, one hand holds a sealed cream letter by hip, other hand inside coat pocket; hem and long braided ponytail lifted slightly by wind. Scene: rain-soaked university cloister at night, Gothic stone arches, slate-blue wet paving, distant dim amber window. More editorial than ordinary trench: overscaled collar/yoke, cocoon sleeves, tall boots, narrow waist and broad hem. Reinterpret researched felted wool, not exact olive runway coat.
